title: Optional: Prep a Hazard Route
briefing: A hazard marker is useful only if you treat it as a warning. Confirm the risk, prepare countermeasures, and mark a retreat route before entering.

objectives.label: Scan the hazard warning
objectives.detail: Identify whether the threat is toxicity, radiation, storm exposure, or another local hazard.

objectives.label: Read route prep guidance
objectives.detail: Use Weather Route Planning before moving into the danger zone.

objectives.label: Pack counterplay supplies
objectives.detail: Carry filters, clean water, food, and a safe return marker before entering.

objectives.label: Mark a retreat path
objectives.detail: Track the hazard marker but keep a known safe zone selected for retreat.

rewards.label: Hazard prep checklist
rewards.detail: Hazard prep checklist appears in Terminal rewards and route records so the payoff is readable before claiming it.

completionText: Hazard route prepared. Enter only when the weather, supplies, and retreat marker all agree.
fieldGuide: Optional hazard prep mission that treats danger markers as planning tools: identify the threat, read the counterplay, pack supplies, and mark retreat before entry.
